description:
Once the emitted answer provably equals the replayed answer, delete the inference: the interval rule (reads UNION previous blocked-set, movement in [previous conclusion, t)) and the state that exists only to track it.

## Measured scope

Delete (~215 lines of method bodies plus shadow types):
  formula side  -- cause 18, woken_by_settled 18, record_movements 32, record_wakes 19
  product side  -- evaluate_product ~113, record_product_movement 13
  shadow types  -- Movement, WaitIdentity, WaitLookup, ProductMovement, FormulaHistory
  plus the per-formula position bookkeeping inside apply (67) and SessionReplay

Keep, restructured as straight tallies over already-emitted events (~370 lines):
  settle_product 48, record_recursive_group 42, record_publication 26, request_product 20,
  finish_session 20, cache_hit 14, product 9, note_definitions 37, record_ground_shifts 37,
  record_non_formula_step 15, and new/run/take_report/assert_complete/dependency_set 57.

FactLifecycle (first_appearances > distinct = the retract-and-remint signature), ShiftWork and the session tallies are legitimate stream folds over emitted events, not inference. They stay.

Estimate roughly 275-300 lines deleted. Do NOT quote 669: that is the whole of impl Replay and most of it is tallying.

Also delete the permanent reads-only red test. It exists to stop someone simplifying an inference rule that will no longer exist.

## Keep a small audit in its place

The one rationale that survives scrutiny is that the engine should not be the sole witness to its own good behaviour. That argues for a checker, not a reconstruction. Replace the derivation with an assertion that every emitted cause appears in that same stream's own changed/movements.

This also fixes an ambiguity that exists today: instrument and audit are the same code, so a non-zero uncaused count cannot distinguish 'the compiler did extra work' from 'the replayer's model is stale'. A small backing assertion fails unambiguously.

The shape already exists to copy: woken_by_settled plus readiness_without_settled_wake is exactly this kind of cheap corroboration, and it ships green.

comments.text: Also delete CausalReport::distinct_demanded_products (causal.rs:758) in this commit: zero callers anywhere, including inside the module. It is pub, so dead_code never fired on it.

title: Delete the causality inference and its interval shadow state
